verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a dedicated Sandbox mode for Identity Verification. It accepts a fixed set of test inputs that produce successful Data Source and Documentary Verification checks, and it supports custom test users created directly in Sandbox, so testing runs separately from live verification. missing for 10: no explicit documentation that Sandbox data is isolated from production, no independent or hands-on corroboration of the Sandbox workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: In Sandbox mode, Identity Verification accepts the fixed set of inputs below in order to result in successful Data Source and Documentary Verification checks.
Plaid supports creating custom test users from your organization directly in Sandbox.
